title: Uruguayan Chicken Wings
description: A flavorful and spicy Uruguayan-inspired dish featuring chicken wings roasted to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, uruguayan hot sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and salt.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray. Arrange the chicken wings on the baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast the chicken wings in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the chicken wings from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
